text:
Kamila Szymanska is a Staff Frontend Engineer at FinTech Innovators Ltd. We collaborated occasionally on cross-team projects, and I’ve followed her work on accessibility and performance improvements.  

Kamila’s work on React architecture at FinTech Innovators directly reduced component re-renders by 35% via custom hooks, which she designed and mentored others on. She also led a TypeScript migration across 120+ components, cutting type-related bugs by 40% in Q3 2023. Her responsive design system, built with Flexbox and CSS Grid, scaled to 8+ breakpoints and became a team standard.  

She owns the state management layer for the company’s core dashboard, using Redux with custom middleware to sync user data across 5+ microservices. This reduced latency by 22% in high-traffic scenarios. Her web accessibility work, including ARIA labels and keyboard navigation, improved compliance scores from 82% to 94% across 10+ pages.  

Kamila is relentlessly detail-oriented, often catching edge cases others miss. She’s a reliable collaborator who balances deep technical expertise with clear communication. Her focus on performance and accessibility sets a high bar for the team.  

Kamila’s technical rigor and commitment to inclusive design make her a standout contributor. I’d welcome the chance to discuss her work further.
